objective: Make cumulative lifecycle evidence mandatory and machine-validated for every meaningful pull request.

baseline.description: Cumulative lifecycle contract and knowledge layer exist, but cycle records are not yet mandatory in pull-request CI.

scientific_validity.reason: This process-control change does not constitute external scientific benchmark evidence.

measurement.trade_off: CI strictness increases; scientific validation remains release-blocking and unchanged.

evidence: Cumulative Lifecycle Gate validates every cycle record.
Pull-request CI requires a cycle record for meaningful changes.
PR #74 merged after all required CI, CodeQL, scientific-validation contract, and cumulative lifecycle checks passed on the accepted head.

root_causes: CI shell variable escaping and unsupported pending regression state were corrected and revalidated.

findings: Advisory lifecycle documentation is insufficient for durable process compliance.
CI can enforce cumulative evidence without coupling it to mutable scientific benchmark data.
